headline: Merchant Marine finishes the season without a defeat
dek: Merchant Marine closed its campaign with eight wins and six draws, allowing just eight goals while scoring 47 along the way. Every other Skyline program dropped multiple matches before the season ended.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the Skyline splits into a top tier and a steep drop-off: Sarah Lawrence's 69 goals exceed the combined totals of mid-table Manhattanville and St. Joseph's-Long Island.

wire.line: St. Joseph's-Brooklyn lost all fourteen matches, scoring two goals while conceding 121.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches on the schedule remain past their dates without a published result: Manhattanville's trips to Bard and William Paterson, and Old Westbury's home date against Medgar Evers College.
